train_data: followup/data/object_world_v1/train; same 1024 scenes for both arms
input_prior: Known six RGB palette directions; distinct colors in source scenes; foreground max>13; each color >=3 pixels. No GT masks, centers or count at inference.
crop: 33x33 mask centered on RGB-mask bounding-box midpoint, zero padded. Predicted center offset is learned.
global: Same RGB-derived mask resized from 64x64 to 33x33; predicts absolute center. Same CNN and parameter count.
targets: Supervised shape, pose, radius 5..8 and xy. Zigzag pose loss modulo 2 due 180-degree raster symmetry.
scoring: Original strict factor checks retained, including pose; also report observationally-equivalent zigzag pose separately. No target-dependent inference.
limits: Shared original training dataset; three new evaluation seeds do not imply three independent training datasets. Palette-assisted, synthetic domain only.
